_readme: Single source of truth for the S.E.T. Jamaica catalog. status: reserve (no payment, notify me) | selling (payment buttons on) | sold_out | hidden. price_jmd stays null until Wayne approves it. A product page is generated only when photos[] has real photos (rule: no product page without real product images). pay.card_link = WiPay/Fygaro payment link; pay.paypal_link = PayPal link; Lynk + bank transfer go through WhatsApp/invoice. Target prices live in research/launch-product-line-2026-09-30.md, not here.
